_meta.notes: Spawn pricing and the playable disk. Free random spawn is always available; named areas and exact coordinates cost spores and are rechecked by the server. Coordinates are spherical latitude/longitude near the north pole of the 100 km planet.

enabled.notes: When false, named areas and exact coordinates are refused while free random spawn still works.

play_radius_m.notes: Radius of the detailed playable disk, measured from the spawn origin. Exact spawns outside it are refused.

spawn_spacing_m.notes: Minimum distance from an existing plant root to a new seed.

exact_coordinate_cost.notes: Spores charged for landing at an exact latitude/longitude.

value.name: Sunmeadow
value.description: Open, level ground with long light and thin shade.

value.name: Root Hollow
value.description: A damp basin where old roots have already broken the soil.

value.name: Stone Reach
value.description: A mineral shelf near the edge of the surveyed ground.

value.name: Mist Terrace
value.description: High, wet ground that holds the morning cloud a little longer.

named_areas.notes: Named areas are priced locations, not separate maps. Their centres and radii are validated against the playable disk at boot.
